name: Zukk'ash Carapace
summary: A Zukk'ash Carapace is evidence taken from the insect-like Zukk'ash in Feralas. Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache wants them while the Horde investigates the threat near the Writhing Deep.

sections.title: Carapace Evidence
sections.body: South of the gnolls in Feralas, the Zukk'ash dwell in the Writhing Deep. Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache seeks their carapaces as evidence while the Horde scouts the insects and their effect on the gnolls. Their presence is troubling enough to demand study.

faq.answer: A Zukk'ash Carapace is the hard covering of one of the insect-like Zukk'ash in Feralas.

faq.q: Where do Zukk'ash Carapaces come from?
faq.answer: The Zukk'ash in Feralas yield carapaces. They dwell in the Writhing Deep, south of the gnolls.
Hadoken Swiftstrider at Camp Mojache wants Zukk'ash Carapaces as evidence of the hunt.

faq.q: Why are the carapaces being collected?
faq.answer: Hadoken Swiftstrider wants the carapaces as evidence and intends to have them analyzed. The Horde hopes to learn more about the Zukk'ash threat.

angles.text: As a member of the Horde, you can help Camp Mojache investigate the Zukk'ash threat by bringing Hadoken Swiftstrider their carapaces as evidence.
